ruleset.name: jpinpoint-nextgen-rules
ruleset.description: jPinpoint "nextgen" rule set: new Kotlin concurrent rules using PMD 7.28.0 type-resolution XPath functions (pmd-kotlin:typeIs, pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation, pmd-kotlin:matchesSig). These rules REQUIRE a PMD version that supports those features and therefore are NOT included in the standard jpinpoint-kotlin-rules.xml, to keep that file working on older PMD versions. See the "Nextgen rules" section in the README for details. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: SynchronizingForLocalVars
rule.description: Problem: Synchronizing a block that only accesses local variables adds locking overhead without protecting shared state. Solution: Only synchronize when the block accesses shared mutable state. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidCompletionServiceTake
rule.description: Problem: take() stalls indefinitely in case of hanging threads and consumes a thread. Solution: use poll() with a timeout value and handle the timeout. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidFutureGetWithoutTimeout
rule.description: Problem: Stalls indefinitely in case of hanging threads and consumes a thread. Solution: Provide a timeout value and handle the timeout. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidCommonPoolForBlockingCalls
rule.message: Avoid parallelStream() for blocking (remote) calls; it uses the ForkJoinPool common pool which can starve other tasks.
rule.description: Problem: parallelStream() uses the ForkJoinPool common pool (shared JVM-wide). Blocking calls (HTTP, DB) starve it. Solution: Use a dedicated ForkJoinPool (submit your parallel work to it), or use Kotlin coroutines with IO dispatcher. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath

rule.name: AvoidExecutorInvokeWithoutTimeout
rule.message: Avoid using ExecutorService::invokeAll or invokeAny without a timeout.
rule.description: Problem: Stalls indefinitely in case of stalled Callable(s) and consumes threads. Solution: Provide a timeout to the invokeAll/invokeAny method and handle the timeout. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidParallelStreamWithCommonPool
rule.message: Beware: parallelStream with the common pool is rarely a good choice.
rule.description: Problem: Collection.parallelStream uses the common pool, with #threads = #CPUs. It is designed to distribute much CPU work over the cores. It is not designed for remote calls or other blocking calls. In addition, parallelizing has CPU overhead and concurrency risks. Solution: Prefer sequential streams or Kotlin sequences, or use a dedicated pool when parallelism is justified. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidFutureJoinWithoutTimeout
rule.description: Problem: Stalls indefinitely in case of hanging thread(s) and consumes a thread. Solution: Provide a timeout before the join and handle the timeout. For example a future.get(timeout, unit), an orTimeout() or a completeOnTimeout(). You may want to use CompletableFuture.allOf() too. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: (: future.join() without any timeout method anywhere in the same function body. The extra "PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/.../@Text = 'join'" check (direct child, not descendant) is NOT redundant here, despite matchesSig() already identifying the signature: confirmed via ast-dump that matchesSig('...Future#join()') spuriously also returns true for OUTER ancestor PostfixUnaryExpression nodes of a multi-line method chain with a trailing lambda (e.g. the whole "return futures.filter{...}.map{it.join()}" expression), even though .join() is nested three levels deep inside an unrelated lambda body, not a direct suffix of that outer node. This looks like the same class of line/position-based type-attribution bug as stokpop/kotlin-type-mapper#36 and PMD PR #7168 (type/call info leaking onto a neighbouring or enclosing declaration for multi-line constructs). The extra check scopes the match back down to the exact node whose own immediate suffix is the ".join()" call. :) //PostfixUnaryExpression[ pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.Future#join()') and PostfixUnarySuffix/NavigationSuffix/SimpleIdentifier/*/@Text = 'join' and not( ancestor::FunctionBody//PostfixUnaryExpression[ pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.Future#get(_,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture#orTimeout(_,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') or pmd-kotlin:matchesSig('java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture#completeOnTimeout(_,_,java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit)') ] ) ]

rule.name: AvoidNonPrivateFieldsInSharedObjects
rule.message: Avoid non-private properties in shared objects. Make properties private to ensure thread-safety.
rule.description: Problem: A singleton, or more general: an object shared among threads, has a property that is not private. These properties can possibly be modified from other classes. Solution: Make the properties private. Note: properties are excluded when annotated with: @Autowired/@Value/@Inject. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value:
(: Kotlin: AvoidNonPrivateFieldsInSharedObjects :) (: Find non-private properties in singleton/shared-object classes :)
(: Match classes annotated as singletons/shared objects, then find non-private, non-val class-level properties within them :) //ClassDeclaration[ ( pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.stereotype.Service') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.stereotype.Component') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.stereotype.Controller') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.stereotype.Repository') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController') ) (: exclude request/prototype scope — not shared :) and not(pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.web.context.annotation.RequestScope')) (: exclude @Scope("request") or @Scope("prototype"). Note: pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation()/typeIs() only resolve correctly when called on the annotated declaration node (here ClassDeclaration), NOT on the Annotation node itself (confirmed empirically - calling them directly on an Annotation node always returns false). So the class-level hasAnnotation() check above guards that a real, resolvable Spring @Scope annotation is present, and we separately pick out the specific Annotation node by its literal name 'Scope' to read its string argument - this also prevents a false exclusion from an unrelated annotation whose argument happens to contain the text "request"/"prototype" (e.g. @RequestMapping("request")). :) and not( pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('org.springframework.context.annotation.Scope') and .//Annotation[.//SimpleIdentifier/*/@Text='Scope']//T-LineStrText[@Text='request' or @Text='prototype'] ) (: exclude @NotThreadSafe :) and not(pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('NotThreadSafe')) ]//PropertyDeclaration[ (: not inside a function body — class-level property (: isWithin pattern :) :) not(ancestor::FunctionBody) (: not private — modifiers() returns a sequence (e.g. a property can be both 'private' and 'lateinit' at once), so '=' here is an existential "contains" check, not scalar equality :) and not(pmd-kotlin:modifiers()='private') (: not val (final) :) and not(T-VAL) (: not injection framework annotated :) and not( pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('Autowired') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('Value') or pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('Inject') ) (: not in a nested class inside the class body :) and not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[ancestor::ClassBody]) ]

rule.name: AvoidMutableStaticFields
rule.message: Avoid mutable static fields. Make val (immutable) or use thread-safe access with @Volatile or @GuardedBy.
rule.description: Problem: Multiple threads typically access static fields. Unguarded assignment to a mutable or non-final static field is thread-unsafe and may cause corruption or visibility problems. To make this thread-safe, that is, guard the field e.g. with synchronized methods, may cause contention. Solution: Make the fields final and unmodifiable. If they really need to be mutable, make access thread-safe: use synchronized and @GuardedBy, use volatile or a suitable concurrent collection type. Consider lock contention. (jpinpoint-rules)

property.name: xpath
property.value: (: isWithin pattern: companion-object field, excluding function-body/lambda-local vars :) //CompanionObject//PropertyDeclaration[ not(ancestor::FunctionBody or ancestor::LambdaLiteral) and @Mutable = true() and not(pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('Volatile')) and not(pmd-kotlin:hasAnnotation('GuardedBy')) ]

rule.name: AvoidStaticXmlFactories
rule.message: XML Factory is used as static/object/companion field. XML factories are not thread-safe. Use local variables instead.
rule.description: An XML Factory like DocumentBuilderFactory, TransformerFactory, MessageFactory is used as static field. Problem: These factory objects are typically not thread-safe and rather expensive to create because of class loading. Solution: Create the Factories as local variables and use command line arguments to specify the implementation class. (jpinpoint-rules)

rule.name: AvoidIncrementOrDecrementForVolatileField
rule.description: Problem: Compound operations on volatile fields are not atomic. Solution: Use AtomicInteger or another atomic type, or guard the updates. (jpinpoint-rules)
